{{Quote|I'm a survivor. Remember?|Romar Adell|<ref name="Ruins of War" />}}
'''Romar Adell''' was a [[human]] [[Gender|male]] from [[Serenno]].<ref name="Ruins of War" /> Adell was, at one [[time]], affiliated with the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems]]<ref name="Comprehensive SWE" /> but eventually lost faith in [[Dooku]], the Separatist [[Head of State]] and reigning [[Count of Serenno]] as he plundered his own people during the [[Clone Wars]].<ref name="Ruins of War" />

Following the [[Bombardment of Serenno|bombardment]] of the [[planet]] by the [[Galactic Empire]], Adell and other fellow [[Serennian]]s went into hiding in the world's [[upper forest region]], where he also built his [[Romar Adell's domicile|domicile]]. He later became an ally of the [[Clone Force 99|Bad Batch]], a group of renegade [[Clone trooper|clones]], who ran into trouble with the Empire on Serenno. After helping them escape a unit of [[stormtrooper]]s, Adell gifted a [[kaleidoscope]] to the Batch's youngest member [[Omega]] and saw them safely off the planet.<ref name="Ruins of War" />

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Romar Adell first appeared in "[[Ruins of War]]," the second episode in the [[The Bad Batch Season 2|second season]] of ''[[Star Wars: The Bad Batch]]''. He was voiced by [[Héctor Elizondo]].<ref name="Ruins of War" />
